title: Local lifting of quotient sections
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\iota:\mathcal I\hookrightarrow\mathcal O_X$ a monomorphism of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with $\mathcal I$ quasi-coherent and of finite type [pqf-def-coherent]. Put $P_n=\mathcal I^n$ with inclusion $j_n:P_n\hookrightarrow\mathcal O_X$ and $P_0=\mathcal O_X$, using the recursive ideal powers of [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk]. Assume $X$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $\mathcal F$ be quasi-coherent. Let $U\subseteq X$ be open with $x\in U$ if and only if $\iota_x$ is surjective. Fix sections $1_n\in P_n(U)$ with $j_n(1_n)=1$ and maps $r_{nm}:P_m\to P_n$ for $n\le m$ with $j_n r_{nm}=j_m$. For an $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal F$ and any open $W$, say a section $s\in\mathcal F(W)$ is annihilated by $P_n$ if for every open $W\prime\subseteq W$ and every $b\in P_n(W\prime)$, the product $j_n(b)s|_{W\prime}$ is zero. Fix quasi-coherent $A_n$, monomorphisms $a_n:A_n\to\mathcal F$ whose sectionwise images are exactly these annihilators, and assume every $\pi_n(W):\mathcal F(W)\to Q_n(W)$ is bijective for $W\subseteq U$, where $Q_n=\operatorname{coker}(a_n)$ and $\pi_n$ is the cokernel projection [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Fix $q_{nm}:Q_n\to Q_m$ with $q_{nm}\pi_n=\pi_m$ for $n\le m$. Then every $s\in\mathcal F(U)$ has $\pi_{n,U}(s)=\varphi_U(1_n)$ for some $n$ and $\varphi:P_n\to Q_n$. No vanishing assertion, colimit, or diagram is part of this conclusion.

proof.text: On an affine open identify the finite type quasi-coherent ideal with a finitely generated ideal J=(f_1,...,f_t), and F with M~ via the affine tilde/Gamma equivalence. Finite generation makes annihilators of J^n commute with localization, so hann and monicity identify A_n with Ann_M(J^n)~, and the quasi-coherent cokernel-image theorem identifies Q_n with (M/Ann_M(J^n))~.

proof.text: Write s on D(f_i) as x_i/f_i^k, with k positive. On overlaps choose a common e with (f_i f_j)^e(f_j^k x_i-f_i^k x_j)=0; replace x_i by f_i^e x_i and k by k+e. Put d=t(k-1)+1 and K={x : every f_i^k x=0}. A monomial of degree d contains f_i^k. Send it to the monomial with that exponent lowered by k, times x_i, modulo K. Multiplying a relation between monomials by f_j^k gives the original relation times x_j, hence zero, so this defines J^d → M/K. The same monomial bound gives K⊆Ann_M(J^d), and thus a map J^d → M/Ann_M(J^d). On D(f_i) its value on f_i^d is f_i^(d-k)x_i, so evaluation is x_i/f_i^k, as required. For t=0 the complement is empty and a positive ideal power supplies the zero map.

proof.text: Choose a finite affine cover with quasi-compact overlaps and construct local lifts by the preceding affine calculation. Transport to a common degree using r and q. Their equations over the monic power inclusions and epic quotient projections imply identity and composition laws and preserve evaluation. On every affine member of a finite overlap cover the difference has zero evaluation into a quasi-coherent cokernel. Cokernel closure and ideal_power_evaluation_eventually_zero on that affine scheme kill the difference after restricting to a later ideal power; composition with q preserves zero. Choose one upper bound for all local and overlap degrees. The local homomorphisms agree and glue by glue_sheaves_of_modules; section uniqueness identifies evaluation with π_n(s). Empty schemes and empty complements use zero maps; the unit ideal uses the global section map in degree zero.

theorem ideal_power_quotient_local_lifting_section
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {I : X.Modules}
    (ι : I ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) [Mono ι]
    [I.IsQuasicoherent] [I.IsFiniteType] [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U : X.Opens) (one : ∀ n : ℕ, Γ((idealSheafPower ι n).1, U))
    (r : ∀ (n m : ℕ), n ≤ m →
      ((idealSheafPower ι m).1 ⟶ (idealSheafPower ι n).1))
    (hU : ∀ x : X, x ∈ U ↔ Function.Surjective
      ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).map ι).hom)
    (hone : ∀ n : ℕ, (idealSheafPower ι n).2.app U (one n) = (1 : Γ(X, U)))
    (hr : ∀ (n m : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m),
      r n m h ≫ (idealSheafPower ι n).2 = (idealSheafPower ι m).2)
    (A : ℕ → X.Modules) (a : ∀ n : ℕ, A n ⟶ F)
    (hmono : ∀ n : ℕ, Mono (a n))
    (hqc : ∀ n : ℕ, (A n).IsQuasicoherent)
    (hann : ∀ (n : ℕ) (W : X.Opens) (s : Γ(F, W)),
      s ∈ Set.range ((a n).app W) ↔
        ∀ (W' : X.Opens) (h : W' ≤ W)
          (b : Γ((idealSheafPower ι n).1, W')),
          (F.smul (U := W') ((idealSheafPower ι n).2.val.app (op W') b)).hom
            (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op s) = 0)
    (hquot : ∀ (n : ℕ) (W : X.Opens), W ≤ U →
      Function.Bijective ((cokernel.π (a n)).app W))
    (q : ∀ (n m : ℕ), n ≤ m → (cokernel (a n) ⟶ cokernel (a m)))
    (hq : ∀ (n m : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m),
      cokernel.π (a n) ≫ q n m h = cokernel.π (a m)) :
    ∀ s : Γ(F, U), ∃ (n : ℕ) (φ : (idealSheafPower ι n).1 ⟶ cokernel (a n)),
      (cokernel.π (a n)).app U s = φ.app U (one n)
